---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new tool, signal, or behaviour
title: "feat: "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## What problem are you trying to solve

Describe the user pain point, not the proposed solution.

## Proposed solution

Concrete description of the change. New tool? New parameter? New scoring
signal?

## Alternatives considered

What else would solve this? Why is the proposed approach better?

## Scope

- [ ] New MCP tool
- [ ] Change to existing tool's parameters / return shape
- [ ] New scoring signal / config knob
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling / CI

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, prior art. Mention if this would be a breaking change
for existing MCP clients.
